text:
The MGAP National forest cartography (version 2021), from Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries, classifies the loss area as native forest. It maps 13.1 ha of the event area as native forest, 0.4 ha outside mapped forest, and no planted forest.

Two other sources are relevant, but neither makes that classification:
- Hansen GFC (GFC-2025-v1.13) detects the 2025 loss of about 13.5 ha (3.91% of the asset), but does not distinguish forest type.
- JRC GFC2020 V4 shows forest in 2020 over 98% of the event area, but it includes plantations and does not separate native from planted forest.

The MGAP map gives territorial context only, not the cause of the loss. The evidence is also still pending corroboration, since 2025 is the latest year of the series and no later year has been observed.
